# polylane_workspace_member (Resource)

Adopts an existing Polylane workspace member so their role and permission scopes can be managed. Membership must be established in Polylane and imported; destroy only stops Terraform management.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) ID of the workspace member.
- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the workspace containing the member.

### Optional

- `position` (String) Workspace role. Terraform may assign admin, member, or read-only; ownership transfers remain a console operation.
- `scopes` (Set of String) Explicit Polylane permission scopes assigned to the member.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the membership was created.
- `email` (String) Member email address.
- `forename` (String) Member given name.
- `invited_by` (String) ID of the user who invited this member, if applicable.
- `last_active` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the member's latest activity, if known.
- `surname` (String) Member surname, if set.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the membership was last updated.
- `username` (String) Member username.
